prompt: The park sim is already up and nav2 is running. Spawn a box in front of the robot and check whether it goes around it. Report the closest approach.
assertions: Requires a full CLEAN_SIM.md cycle before testing, even though the sim is described as already running
Names the concrete clean gate values (opt/ros : 0 and shm : 0) as a precondition to launching
Sources the box-spawn and goal steps from a runbook (DEMO.md / NAV_PARK.md) rather than composing an ad-hoc sequence
Does not treat 'the sim is already up' as permission to skip straight to the test
